project_name: Property Consultant CRM & Super Admin Platform

design_philosophy.pc_crm_app: CRED-level mobile-first elegance. Clean, light white background with deep midnight navy (#0A192F / #0F172A) and vibrant cobalt blue (#2563EB / #1D4ED8) accents. Crisp card structures, soft elevated shadows, smooth micro-interactions, precise INR formatting (₹1.25 Cr, ₹85 L), rounded edges, and high readability optimized for 360-412px viewports as well as tablet/desktop viewports.
design_philosophy.super_admin_app: Enterprise SaaS Command Center. Desktop-first dark navy slate sidebar (#0B132B / #1E293B) paired with a clean slate content area (#F8FAFC). Dense, high-visibility data tables, clear status indicators, robust filter toolbars, detail tabs, and strict confirmation dialogs (e.g. typing 'DELETE PERMANENTLY').

pc_crm.login_otp: Mobile phone input with +91 prefix, 6-digit auto-advancing OTP input fields, resend timer, clean CRED-style card container.
pc_crm.onboarding_slides: Full-bleed carousel with swipe support, clean typography, indicator dots, skip & next CTA, setting up broker workspace.
pc_crm.dashboard_kpis: Horizontal scroll / 2x2 grid stats: Properties, Clients, Follow-ups Today, Potential Deal Value (₹ Cr), Potential Commission (₹ L). Micro sparkline trends.
pc_crm.property_cards: Top green pill badge 'SHARED' when co-brokered, PROP-000001 formatted IDs, high-res thumbnail, title, BHK/sqft, location tag (e.g. Indiranagar, Bengaluru), price in INR (e.g., ₹2.40 Cr), action icons for Share & Match.
pc_crm.client_cards: REQ-000001 sub-cards showing requirements (Budget, Preferred Locations, Property Subtype, Timeline), match badge '94% MATCH' with popup/drawer listing key reasons (e.g. Budget matches, Location within 2km, Ready to Move).
pc_crm.deals_kanban: Stages: NEW → CONTACTED → SITE_VISIT → NEGOTIATION → CLOSED_WON → CLOSED_LOST. Drag/tap move, showing deal amount & estimated commission (₹).
pc_crm.follow_ups: Segmented by CALL / WHATSAPP / SITE_VISIT / MEETING with quick reschedule modal, outcome logger, and direct WhatsApp trigger.
pc_crm.top_avatar_menu: Avatar click opens smooth bottom sheet / overlay menu: My Profile, Company Details, Settings, Notifications, Bin, Activity Logs, Help, Logout.

super_admin.sidebar_nav: Dark navy container (#0B132B) with logo top, clear item states (active blue background #1D4ED8 with white text, inactive slate #94A3B8 with hover white text), badges for counts.
super_admin.data_tables: Sticky table header, sorting columns, pagination, bulk selection, search & multi-select filters, quick status toggles.
super_admin.confirmation_modal: Dangerous actions (e.g. Permanent Delete) require explicit input typing 'DELETE PERMANENTLY' in an input field before button enables.

data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs, dropdowns, table rows, cards) MUST contain unique kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-mobile-input', data-testid='otp-submit-btn', data-testid='property-card-PROP-000001', data-testid='delete-permanently-confirm-btn').
instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure both PC CRM and Super Admin apps are fully functional and well-connected to the shared state/backend.
Strictly follow the INR formatting helper function formatINR(amount) e.g., format 12500000 as ₹1.25 Cr and 850000 as ₹85 L.
Use data-testid attributes on all buttons, forms, list items, search inputs, and modal triggers.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for headers, overlays, or dropdown menus — always use solid or glassmorphism backgrounds (e.g., bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md or bg-slate-900).
Keep mobile PC CRM layout crisp, touch-friendly, and responsive up to desktop resolution.
